notes: Paper presents both NEW MEASURED limits from PrimEx published diphoton spectrum (Fig. 2 of Ref. [30], digitized in supplemental Fig. S2) and PROJECTIONS for future GlueX running. The measured limits from PrimEx are world-leading at a few masses (0.11–0.15 GeV). The coupling_type is AxionPhoton because the paper constrains g_agamma (denoted cγ/Λ) via the a→γγ decay width in Primakoff production. Two scenarios studied: (1) ALP-photon coupling dominant (cγ=1, cg=0) shown in Fig. 2; (2) ALP-gluon coupling dominant (cγ=0, cg=1) shown in Fig. 3. Data points extracted primarily from Fig. 2 (photon coupling case) which is the main result. The mass range 0.03 ≲ ma ≲ 0.3 GeV is where PrimEx provides best sensitivity. Extracted approximate coupling values from the figure; exact numerical values require reading from published plots. The paper uses a data-driven normalization method eliminating need for form factors or flux knowledge. Confidence level 0.95 is standard for bump-hunt exclusion limits. Extraction confidence 0.75 reflects that numerical values are approximate from figure reading rather than explicit table. | [VISION GATE C] extracted mass window is 10.9 dex outside the abstract-stated range [3e+07, 3e+08] eV — wrong figure/panel/regime traced
